intended_object: An auto-generated proof certificate. Its docstring calls it a "checked nominal proof certificate" with the upstream name nb093_wpp_refl_0029. It shows that a specific environment of alpha-dummy terms is reflexive on the free variables of the syntax synCfound.
explanation: The definition is a generated piece of proof data inside the library's NF-choice compiler and replay setup. Its type is a TReflOn statement about one particular environment, built from auxiliary terms nb093AlphaDummy000 through nb093AlphaDummy007, and about the free variables of the fixed syntax synCfound. Its body just applies TEnvFresh.reflOn to another certificate, nb093_compact_envfresh_0029. It is an implementation and proof-replay device with no counterpart in the mathematical literature, so faithfulness and generality do not apply.
